notes.title: Major Update 3 - The Anniversary Update:
notes.notes:
[u][b]Major Update 3 - The Anniversary Update:[/b][/u]
What an incredible year it has been, and what better way to celebrate it than with a ton of updates crammed into the biggest singular update in PWAG's history!

[u][b]Dark Deals:[/b][/u]
[i]Occasionally you are offered a Tarot Pack in your vending machine. Opening the pack replaces your next machine with a Major Arcana Shop, which grants you access to the strongest items in the game. But these items come with the drawback of adding more foes to the enemy ranks, so use their power cautiously.[/i]
[list]
[*] New Item: Tarot Pack - Replaces next shop with tarot offering
[*] New: Tarot Card - Death
[*] New: Tarot Card - Temperance
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Devil
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Hermit
[*] New: Tarot Card - The High Priestess
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Fool
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Emperor
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Empress
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Magician
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Sun
[*] New: Tarot Card - The Tower
[*] New: Tarot Card - Wheel of Fortune
[/list]

[u][b]Collab Update:[/b][/u]
[b]Collab 1 - BassKnightVA:[/b]
PWAG has a super serious and intense lore to the game, so to help emphasis this BassKnight is assisting by adding voice acting to the game! You will get to hear them announce the cover, intro sequence, and the true ending of the game. They are extremely talented, and hearing them voice this game has been such a wonderful experience! And I believe that you too will get to feel the gravity behind Father Garcia’s fight brought to life by their voice acting!
[b]Collab 2 - RossBoomSocks:[/b]
Ross is a streamer I have watched for the past 8 years of my life, so getting his permission to add his mascot to PWAG was huge news to me. Somewhere in the park you will be able to find a drawer, where you can recruit Sockrates to aid in the fight against evil. Sockrates will somewhat function as a mix between a recruited stray animal (like the dog) and an item, in that he is leveled up via the vending machine.

[u][b]Polish Update Part 2:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New: Item inventory (hover over an item to see what it does!)
[*] New: Vending Machine UI now looks like a vending machine
[*] New: See your real-time stats while in shops
[*] New: HUD has Wave Progress bar to indicate remaining enemies
[*] QOL: Controls are displayed under HUD icons
[*] QOL: The Pause menu now displays random hints
[*] QOL: Reticle indicates who you are targeting in auto-aim mode
[*] QOL: Wave and Enemy display improved to be more visually pleasing
[*] QOL: Intro sequence reworked to be more visually pleasing
[*] QOL: Important text is outlined to be more legible
[/list]

[b][u]Strays Update:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] New: Stray Cat - Flies around on a broom and rapidly scratches enemies
[*] New: Stray Raccoon - Rummages through trash cans to retrieve items for you
[*] Balance: Stray Dog costs less money to feed
[*] QOL: Stray Dog’s bowl is more visible
[*] QOL: Strays’ level up locations are where you rescue them from (instead of by the vending machine)
[/list]

[u][b]The Town Update:[/b][/u]
[i]Occasionally your bus pass will appear in the vending machine. Buy it to visit town at the end of the wave![/i]
[list]
[*] New: The Casino - Let’s go gambling!
[*] New: The Gun Smith - Upgrade core stats of your gun for the run
[*] New: The Shooting Range - Test your damage output on dummies
[*] New: The Pond - A stranded imp needs help
[/list]

[u][b]General & Bugs:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New Gun: Blessed Beehive (suggested by hoze424)
[*] New Achievement: Join the Sock Drawer - Recruit Sockrates
[*] New Achievement: The Start of a Journey - Recruit the stray cat
[*] New Achievement: Pain Delivery Service - Reach max level with the stray cat
[*] New Achievement: One Man’s Trash… - Recruit the stray raccoon
[*] New Achievement: Master Thief - Reach max level with the stray raccoon
[*] New Achievement: Let’s Go Gambling! - Visit the Casino in town
[*] New Achievement: Call it an Investment - Use the ATM to go into debt
[*] New Achievement: Bee Keeper - Win using the beehive
[*] New Achievement: But What Did it Cost? - Accept a Tarot Card deal
[*] Balance: Increased starting stats of Disciple difficulty
[*] Balance: Increased starting stats of Priest difficulty
[*] Balance: Warlocks shoot less bullets
[*] Balance: RolliBullies no longer are immune to damage while rolling and instead resist damage while rolling
[*] Balance: All on-hits can apply Rootbeer, but its chance to spawn is lower
[*] Balance: Secret Lamp boss can no longer spawn during initial waves of the game
[*] Bug Fix: Pausing no longer has a slight delay
[*] Bug Fix: Healing before vending machine no longer causes a super loud noise
[*] Bug Fix: Rootbeer no longer spawns a root per game frame on hit
[/list]

[b]Lastly, a message to you as a player.[/b]
Hey vending machine enthusiast! Whether you have dumped hours into this game or have never played it and are just reading this for some reason, thank you. Thank you for the time you have given my game out of all the vast amount of games on Steam. This game is jank and goofy and at times confusing, but it was a blast to make and I hope you’ve had fun playing it! I’m thankful for the support that I’ve gotten and for all the people who have showed their excitement throughout this journey. Thank you for a great year!

That’s all for now! Stay safe, and good luck with your next vending machine run!

notes.title: The Shop Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]The Shop Update:[/b][/u]
Want to earn cool cosmetics to show off your dedication to demon-fighting? Well now you can! By playing PWAG you’ll earn Lire, which you can use to buy a large variety of cosmetics. [i]And don’t worry, there are NO micro-transactions, as that is an unholy thing.[/i]

[b]How to Earn Lire:[/b]
[i]This is earned entirely by just playing the game! Each game mode offers a slightly different way to earn it though:[/i]
[b]Classic: [/b]Gain 1 Lira per wave. On boss waves earn 2|4|6|8 depending on your difficulty.
[b]Survival:[/b] Earn 2 Lire per minute each minute (example: earn 2 Lire at 1 min. and another 4 Lire at 2 min.)
[b]Boss Rush: [/b]Earn 2 Lire per boss kill.

[u][b]Cosmetics Store:[/b][/u]
[i]For spending your hard earned Lire![/i]
[list]
[*] Reticle patterns
[*] Reticle colors
[*] Cross styles
[*] Cross colors
[*] Cathedral decorations
[*] Garden decorations
[*] Pond decorations
[*] Cassock styles
[*] Player hats
[/list]

[u][b]General Updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Seasonal: Default map is no longer the Winter map
[*] New Leaderboard: Added “Hall of Saints” to celebrate all players who achieved Completionist on Steam (located under Extras)
[*] New Rare Item: Garlic Sauce (Courtesy of Nai)
[*] New Achievement: “Theologian” - Collect all Cross cosmetics
[*] New Achievement: “The Priest Wears Prada” - Collect all Outfit cosmetics
[*] New Achievement: “Gun Nut” - Collect all Reticle cosmetics
[*] New Achievement: “Interior Decorator” - Collect all Cathedral furnishings
[*] New Achievement: “Garcia the Gardener” - Collect all Garden upgrades
[*] New Achievement: “Holy Waters” - Collect all Pond upgrades
[*] New Achievement: “Spirit of the Garden” - Find the Kodama
[*] New Achievement: “Matthew 14:28-29” - Walk on water
[/list]

[i]Also a big thank you to the reddit Pixel Art community for all the amazing art that helped inspire many of the cosmetics added to the Cathedral. While most of the users I referenced have deleted accounts, thus I am unable to give them direct credit, that community was a lot of help, so definitely check them out for more cool pixel art![/i]

That's all for now! Stay safe, and good luck with your next vending machine run!

notes.title: Major Update: The S.E.X. Update
notes.notes:
[b][u]The S.E.X. Update:[/u][/b]
S.E.X. lovers rejoice, as now PWAG has everything you could want! To help orient you for your next run though, allow me to break down what this update entails.

[b][u]Secret Realms:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] A mysterious altar that allows you the ability to gain access to various realms
[*] Find and beat a new secret mini-boss to unlock a leech friend
[*] Beat all main realms and gain access to the true final boss of the outbreak
[/list]

[b][u]Expression:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Show off your favorite color by using it to wreak havoc against demons
[*] Money talks, so show your support for imps by donating to their union!
[*] Tired of everyone telling you that you have to accept the imp shrines? Show off your rebellious side by desecrating the statues instead!
[/list]

[b][u]Xeric Maps:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] New Halloween map that includes map-exclusive "trick or treat" cauldrons (default for this season)
[*] New Western map for all the cowboy and cowgirl lovers
[/list]

[u][b]General:[/b][/u]
Of course, no S.E.X. update would be complete without some aftercare for the game. So here is everything else that has been addressed:
[b][u]Balance Changes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Balance: Slightly increased final boss HP
[*] Balance: Disciple (Easy) difficulty starting money increased
[*] Balance: Tweaked initial spawn rates of bosses in Endless
[*] Balance: Nerfed Wendigo (so he isn’t one of the hardest bosses)
[*] Balance: Wraiths shoot less frequently on Disciple (Easy) mode
[/list]
[b][u]Quality of Life Changes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] QOL: Boss health bars are much more visible
[*] QOL: Arrows to shrines fade out as player is further from shrine
[*] QOL: Cross indicator is hidden if there is nothing to point towards
[*] QOL: Death screen now pays proper tribute to its inspiration
[/list]
[b][u]Items:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Change: Liquid Death - now chance-based (20%) but much cheaper ($50)
[*] Change: Gravy - now gain $10-$50 on using favorite color
[*] Change: Milk - now heal +1 on using favorite color
[*] Removed: Sparkling Water - (collisions stopped working if bullet speed exceeded fps)
[/list]
[b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Playing on Pride no longer displays as “Envy”
[*] Bug Fix: Hitting the “Back” button on the Difficulty menu no longer mutes music
[*] Bug Fix: Spamming pause and unpause while shooting no longer can crash the game
[*] Bug Fix: No longer can kill enemies and gain money while in the shop
[*] Bug Fix: Removed audio glitch where final boss kept playing death sound
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed several visual bugs for item pick-ups in Survival mode
[*] Bug Fix: Can no longer get trapped inside of terrain by dashing into it
[*] Bug Fix: Intro story sequence is no longer awkwardly silent
[/list]

That's all for now! Stay safe, and good luck with your next vending machine run!
And Happy Halloween!!

notes.title: Major Update: The Progression Update
notes.notes:
[b][u]The Progression Update:[/u][/b]
Ever found yourself bragging to a friend about how great you are at turning vending machine items into weapons to slay demons, but you're unable to actually prove it? Well, now you can with 46 total achievements that can show just how skilled you are at vending machine runs!
[list]
[*] 45 achievements that test expert priests and easter-egg hunters alike
[*] A 46th achievement for those who proved themselves to be a master of all facets of fighting demons
[/list]

[u][b]Agency Content:[/b][/u]
A major update wouldn't be major with just adding achievements, so to add more life to the park there are a lot of new mechanics in play. Player agency is important in games, and although rogue-likes have to have a good bit of luck, now you have many more ways to alter that luck! This demonic outbreak has recruited another new boss from the depths of the ocean to fight you with, but luckily you have several new weapons and allies at your disposal to help you fight it off!
[list]
[*] Content: A shady tent that might make your weapon stronger
[*] Content: A stray dog that you can recruit as a companion
[*] Content: A bar where you can buy strong one-time-use powerups
[*] Content: One or more challenge shrines that offer rewards along with great risks
[*] Content: Teleporters that connect once both are repaired
[*] Content: Choose from 1 of 7 powerful buffs each time you beat a boss
[*] New weapon: Righteous Rocketeer
[*] New weapon: Faithful Flamethrower
[*] New Boss: The Dredge
[*] New Item: Lime Juice
[*] New Item: Seven Up
[*] New Item: Liquid Death
[/list]

[u][b]General Updates:[/b][/u]
Other aspects of the game have received additional love and polish. Lots of quality of life has been added from auto-aim to volume control to enemy health bars. Below is a list of all the smaller changes:
[list]
[*] Accessibility: Auto-aim is now available
[*] Seasonal: Default map is back to normal (Summer map can be accessed in Extras)
[*] Gameplay: Bosses appear every 8th wave. (To speed up gameplay)
[*] Balance: Start with 1 dash by default (for all you Dark Souls enthusiasts)
[*] Balance: Tweaks to costs of vending machine items
[*] Balance: Music path must be unlocked each run
[*] Balance: Dessert path must be unlocked each run
[*] Balance: Slight buffs to Shotgun and Pistol
[*] Balance: Imps now start with 2 HP
[*] Balance: Changes to reward money given by various enemies
[*] Balance: Tweaks to boss healths and reward money
[*] Balance: Vatican/Exorcist extra enemies no longer spawn on boss waves
[*] Balance: Less bosses initially spawn in Endless
[*] Balance: Nerf to Encore (Revive every 5 waves -> Revive every 10 waves)
[*] Content: Added more *gravitas* to final boss fight
[*] QOL: Reticle size increased on controllers
[*] QOL: Difficulty settings are remembered between runs
[*] QOL: Items that have reached max benefit are removed from the item pool (ex: 100% crit means no more ink)
[*] QOL: HUD displays how long until next boss
[*] QOL: Increased telegraphing from final boss as to which attack it will choose
[*] QOL: Volume button added to menu (hopefully no more eardrums will be broken)
[*] QOL: Choose how you want enemy HP to be displayed (number, health bar, or hidden until damaged). Can be found in Extras-Cosmetics
[/list]

[b][u]Bug FIxes:[/u][/b]
Lastly, no update is complete without admitting that prior code had flaws:
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Endless no longer skips Wave 41
[*] Bug Fix: Dashes properly give I-Frames and can no longer glitch the player into objects
[*] Bug Fix: Throwing a bomb on Controller no longer throws all bombs at once
[*] Bug Fix: Using a potion on Controller no longer uses all potions at once
[*] Bug Fix: Interest no longer breaks if you own more than 100%
[*] Bug Fix: Big bullets no longer disappear when standing against a wall (big bullet lovers rejoice!)
[*] Bug Fix: Ignis no longer spawns fire while the player is still in the shop
[*] Bug Fix: Having several damage multipliers now properly scale off of each other (ex, Tres Leches can crit)
[*] Bug Fix: I-Frames no longer persist between waves
[*] Bug Fix: Dying during Wendigo’s skull attack no longer can crash the game
[*] Bug Fix: Pickups now spawn on the wave that you buy them
[*] Bug Fix: Cap added to bullet speed to prevent softlocks
[*] Bug Fix: Mass buying Iced Coffee no longer will lag/crash game
[*] Bug Fix: Mass buying Spiked Lemonade no longer will lag/crash game
[*] Bug Fix: Mass buying Benedict Beer with Koolaid no longer will lag/crash game
[/list]

As always all feedback and suggestions are appreciated! This is by far the most I have tried to pull off at once in an update, so I hope it is enjoyed! That's all for now. Stay safe, and good luck with your next vending machine run!

notes.title: Major Update: 08/04/24
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Wanted to update everyone that the first major update is in the works with lots of new features! The update is planned to come August 4th, so stay tuned for it!

While I want to stay vague about some of the new mechanics, here's a general overview of some of the things to look forward to:
[list]
[*] Big improvements to final boss fight
[*] 25+ Steam Achievements
[*] New starting weapon
[*] New high-risk high-reward options (for all you gamblers out there)
[*] New reward system for beating bosses
[*] Lots of quality of life changes
[*] Multiple balance changes and bug fixes
[/list]

That's all for now! Stay safe, and good luck with your next vending machine run!

P.S. [i]Sorry to everyone who has been trying to get the existing achievements on the Steam page. The code to actually acquire those is not yet in the live patch. But thank you for wanting to find them and remember where they are for when achievements go live![/i]

[b][u]The Controller Update:[/u][/b]
For those who prefer the feel of a controller game, PWAG is now compatible with a controller! Just turn your device on and start moving your joystick and you're good to go. And if you ever want to switch back just click your mouse and you are back to mouse and keyboard bindings!

[/list]

notes.title: The Survival Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]The Survival Update:[/b][/u]
A new gamemode where the demons never stop coming from the surrounding forest. Fight them off with some familiar items that you can find lying about, along with unique and powerful temporary buffs. No matter what though, the swarm will never end. How far can you get?
[list]
[*] New Gamemode: Survival (found under Extras)
[/list]

[u][b]Minor Updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] General: A "Credits" tab has been added (found under Extras)
[*] QOL: Spark's fire noise compounding reduced
[*] Bug Fix: Poisoning Stalkers no longer can crash the game
[*] Bug Fix: Jet Fuel works even if you only have 1
[/list]

[u][b]Dev Update:[/b][/u]
As we get deeper into Summer, development will probably slow down for the game, both due to busyness and a lack of passionate ideas. More can always be added to the game, but I don't want to force anything that does not feel right. That being said as I continue to find new things that I want to add, I'll continue to add. Any ideas are always appreciated!

That's all for now. Stay safe, and good luck with your next vending machine run!

notes.title: Dev Thoughts 2 - Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1][u][b]The Devotion Update: Art and Indulgences[/b][/u][/h1]

[b][u]Major Update:[/u][/b]
Locate the imp or the piano on the map to accept their deal if you dare. Choosing a deal sets you down a path to gain incredibly powerful items, at the cost of tithing either your health or money. The more devoted to the path you become the steeper the rewards and costs. Be careful which path you choose, as you can only choose one, and there is no going back!

[u][b]General Changes:[/b][/u]
A handful of bugs have also been addressed along with trying to improve overall gameplay. Early waves currently feel a little slow, along with some enemies feeling unfair in certain difficulties. Some tweaks have been implemented to try to fix these, but continue providing feedback so early waves can feel challenging without feeling boring or unfair. Here are all of the other changes:
[list]
[*] Tweaks to spawn rates (to speed up gameplay)
[*] Tweaks to enemy collisions
[*] Increased reticle size
[*] Added animations to Ignis, Summoner, and Charger
[*] Summoner nerfed to lose health on spawning Grunts
[*] Ignis buffed to attack faster and move quicker over fires
[*] Vatican & Exorcist difficulties now impact how Endless Scales
[*] Endless scaling increased to up the challenge for endless enjoyers
[*] Damage & Heal numbers
[*] Updated in-game UI
[*] Removed Item: Demon Blood
[*] Removed Item: Library Latte (don't worry, it's just been moved!)
[*] Removed Enemy: HP Shrine (in favor of all enemies seeking out the player)
[*] Removed Enemy: Curse (for now)
